s.note: Grilled sandwiches of thick-cut marmalade, ham and cheddar
s.how: Butter 8 slices of thick white bread on one side. On the unbuttered sides of 4 slices spread 1 tbsp thick-cut marmalade each, then add 150g sliced ham and 150g grated vintage cheddar. Close with the other slices, butter side out. Cook in a frying pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and the cheese melts. Cut into squares.

s.note: Lime and ají amarillo mashed potato layered with shredded chicken
s.how: Boil 800g potatoes, mash smooth with the juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp ají amarillo paste, 3 tbsp oil and salt. Mix 300g cooked shredded chicken breast with 3 tbsp mayonnaise. Layer potato, chicken, sliced avocado and more potato in a tin, chill 1 hour and cut into squares.

m.note: Wok-seared beef, red onion and tomato with soy, over crisp fries
m.how: Bake 500g frozen fries until crisp. Sear 600g sliced beef rump in a smoking wok, add 1 sliced red onion and 2 tomatoes in wedges, then 3 tbsp soy and 1 tbsp vinegar. Toss through the chips and serve with 300g cooked rice.

w.note: Crumbly shortbread cookies sandwiched with dulce de leche
w.how: Beat 150g butter with 80g icing sugar, then mix in 150g cornflour and 100g flour. Roll 5mm thick, cut 24 rounds and bake at 170C for 10 minutes until pale. Sandwich in pairs with 300g dulce de leche and roll the edges in coconut.

d.note: Purple corn drink simmered with pineapple, cinnamon and clove
d.how: Simmer 250g dried purple corn with the peel and core of 1 pineapple, 2 cinnamon sticks and 4 cloves in 2L water for 45 minutes. Strain, stir in 100g sugar and the juice of 2 limes, and chill. Serve over ice.
